title: Document Age and Validity Standards for Personal Sender Account Verification
content:
Verification documents for a Personal Sender Account are measured against four date standards. Each standard is set per verification level, and every one is counted in calendar days against the date Paloma received the document.

| Level | Proof of address: largest age, issue date to received date (days) | Government ID: fewest days still to run, received date to expiry date (days) | Source-of-funds document: largest age, issue date to received date (days) | Bank statement set: largest age of the most recent statement, issue date to received date (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 90 | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| Paloma Verified | 90 | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 90 | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 90 | 60 | 120 | 0 |
| Paloma Premier | 90 | 90 | 90 | 45 |
| Paloma Private Client | 90 | 90 | 90 | 45 |

A figure of 0 in the source-of-funds or bank statement column means that standard does not apply at that level.

## How the columns read

- **Proof of address** — the largest age, in calendar days counted from the date printed on the document to the date Paloma received it, of an acceptable proof of address. It is 90 days at every level.
- **Government ID** — the fewest calendar days a government ID must still have before its printed expiry date, counted from the date Paloma received it.
- **Source-of-funds document** — the largest age, from issue date to received date, of an acceptable source-of-funds document; it applies from Paloma Enhanced upward.
- **Bank statement set** — the largest age, from the most recent statement's issue date to its received date, of an acceptable set of bank statements; it applies at Paloma Premier and Paloma Private Client.

## Worked reading (hypothetical dates)

A government ID received on a given day with an expiry date exactly 60 calendar days later meets the 60-day standard of Paloma Enhanced; one expiring 59 days after receipt does not. A proof of address dated 90 days before its received date is within the 90-day standard; one dated 91 days before is not. The dates are hypothetical and chosen only to show both sides of each boundary.
